40	function stalledDays(stalledAt: string): number {
41	  const ms = Date.now() - new Date(stalledAt).getTime()
42	  return Math.floor(ms / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24))
43	}

50	  const {
51	    pool_cents,
52	    applied_cents,
53	    status,
54	    sessions_completed,
55	    total_sessions_planned,
56	    stalled_at,
57	  } = input
58	
59	  // Stalled takes highest priority
60	  if (stalled_at) {
61	    const days = stalledDays(stalled_at)
62	    return {
63	      variant: 'amber-stalled',
64	      label: `Stalled ${days}d`,
65	    }
66	  }
67	
68	  // Completed or healing + all sessions done = paid in full
69	  const isTerminalStatus = status === 'completed' || status === 'healing'
70	  const allSessionsDone =
71	    total_sessions_planned !== null && sessions_completed >= total_sessions_planned
72	
73	  if (isTerminalStatus && allSessionsDone) {
74	    return { variant: 'green-paid-full', label: 'Paid in full' }
75	  }
76

78	  if (pool_cents > 0 && applied_cents >= pool_cents) {
79	    return { variant: 'indigo-applied', label: 'Pool applied' }
80	  }
81	
82	  // Pool has funds remaining
83	  if (pool_cents > 0) {
84	    const dollars = (pool_cents / 100).toLocaleString('en-US', {
85	      style: 'currency',
86	      currency: 'USD',
87	      minimumFractionDigits: 0,
88	      maximumFractionDigits: 0,
89	    })
90	    return { variant: 'green-pool', label: `${dollars} in pool` }
91	  }
92	
93	  // No pool yet
94	  return { variant: 'amber-pending', label: 'Deposit pending' }
95	}

102	  const safeApplied = Math.max(0, Math.min(applied_cents, safePool))

105	    applied: safeApplied,

107	  }
